state.objective: Evaluate dimensional compression of the client's prepaid, tax, accrued-expense and advance accounts while preserving asset/liability/expense nature, statutory tax reporting, cut-off and reconciliation.
confirmed_context: Finance is centralized at HO; site_id and cost_center are available dimensions.
No contracts, prepaid schedules, tax returns, tax ledger, accrual roll-forward, advance aging, postings or balances have been supplied.
Account-name similarity is not sufficient for final migration.
Asset and liability accounts must not be netted automatically.
A schedule/subledger can store document, counterparty/employee, start/end date, amortization, due date, tax code, tax period, settlement and site/cost center.

prepaid_nature.instructions: Must prepaid expenses remain separate from current-period expenses even when expense_type is available?

criteria.separate: Keep prepaid asset/control account and release through a schedule.

nine_prepaids.instructions: Can nine prepaid-expense accounts become fewer prepaid control GLs with prepaid_type, contract_id and amortization schedule?

criteria.conditional: Yes, if classification, lease/capitalization treatment, reporting and reconciliation align.
criteria.retain9: Every prepaid type must remain a GL.

rent_prepaids.instructions: Can land/store/house/vehicle prepaid rent be merged before reviewing lease contracts and right-of-use treatment?

criteria.no: Review contracts and accounting policy first.
criteria.yes: All are ordinary prepaid rent automatically.

permit_promotion.instructions: Do business permits and prepaid promotion automatically have the same recognition/amortization pattern as insurance or maintenance contracts?

criteria.no: Validate benefit period and recognition separately.
criteria.yes: All prepaid types have identical treatment.

tax_dimension.instructions: May tax code and tax period move to a tax subledger rather than one GL per tax type?

criteria.conditional: Yes, while retaining natural accounts needed for asset/liability and statutory presentation.
criteria.never: Every tax code must always be a GL.
criteria.one_net: Use one net tax account for every asset and liability.

prepaid_tax_six_to_one.instructions: Can six prepaid-tax families become one Tax Credits/Prepaid Tax GL from names alone?

criteria.review: Input VAT, income-tax installments/credits, PBB and other taxes may require separate recognition and presentation; verify returns and reconciliation.

tax_payable_five_to_one.instructions: Can five tax-payable families become one Tax Payable GL with tax_code detail?

criteria.conditional: Possible if statutory returns, due dates, presentation and reconciliation are reliably separated in the tax ledger.

input_output_vat.instructions: Can Input VAT asset and Output VAT liability be automatically posted to one net natural account?

criteria.no: Track separately and net only according to enforceable tax rules and return settlement.

current_tax_pph25.instructions: Can Current Tax Inc/Exp PPh 25 be classified conclusively from its name?

criteria.no: Inspect whether it contains tax expense, installment/credit, true-up, payable or clearing postings.
criteria.expense: Treat entirely as current tax expense.

accrual_nature.instructions: Must accrued expenses remain separate from the underlying expense accounts?

criteria.separate: Accrued liability remains separate; link accrual_type to expense nature and reversal/settlement.

ten_accruals.instructions: Can ten accrued-expense liability accounts become fewer control GLs with accrual_type and schedule detail?

criteria.conditional: Yes, if payroll, interest, utilities, rent and benefit obligations remain reportable and reconciled.
criteria.retain10: Every accrual type must remain a GL.

payroll_accrual.instructions: Should salary, bonus/severance, medical and BPJS accruals automatically merge with utilities and rent accruals?

criteria.review: Payroll/employee-benefit obligations may require distinct settlement, statutory and disclosure controls.

interest_accrual.instructions: Should accrued loan interest automatically merge with operating accruals?

criteria.review: Facility linkage, effective-interest reconciliation and financing presentation may justify separation.
criteria.loan: Add it to loan principal automatically.

advances_four.instructions: Can four advance accounts become fewer Advance control GLs using advance_purpose, employee/vendor/contractor party and aging?

criteria.conditional: Yes, provided employee and supplier/contractor advances remain distinguishable for settlement, tax and presentation.
criteria.one_now: Merge all immediately without workflow evidence.

other_accounts.instructions: Should Other Prepaid, Other Tax and Other Advance become unrestricted catch-all posting accounts?

criteria.no: Use controlled reason codes, approval, thresholds and aging review.
criteria.yes: Use them as default accounts for compression.

criteria.full: Contracts/schedules, tax returns and ledger, statutory mapping, accrual roll-forwards, advance aging, postings, opening balances and subledger-to-GL reconciliation.
